speaker: Girl
original_jp: 海賊出ないなあ… せっかく港で待ってるのにもしかして もうどこかに行っちゃったのかな
original_en:
Where are the pirates? I came to see them!
I wonder if they've already gone.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: 安全が確認できない限り 船は出せないぜ港出る〓から撃〓されちゃ たまらねえからな <PART> ディパンのバルバロッサ王が何とか対策を〓じてくれればいいんだが…
original_en:
No departures until it's absolutely safe <PART> ---- <PART>
wouldn't want to be sunk right out of port. <PART>
---
It would be nice if King Barbarossa of
Dipan would do something about it, though.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: まったく… ソルデで船乗りやって長いが海賊に船〓められるなんて初めてだぜ
original_en:
Unbelievable. I've sailed Solde a long time,
but I'd never been sunk by pirates until now!

speaker: Girl
original_jp: ねえねえ 海賊が出たっていうの聞いた？この辺で海賊なんて初めて！ <PART> カッコイイお兄さん？ それともオシサンかなあちょっと見てみたかったかも
original_en:
Hey, did you hear about the pirates?
First time we've seen 'em in these waters! <PART>
---
Part of me wants to find out if they're
super-cute guys or wrinkly old lechers.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 港で待ってれば 海賊見られるかなああ でも 海賊出たら船〓められちゃうのか…
original_en:
I might see the pirates if I sail near the
docks. Still, if they see me, I'm sunk.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: アンタも渡航〓望者か？ダメダメ 当分船は動かないってよ <PART> 何でも海賊が出て 船が焼き払われたらしいどうしても渡りたきゃ イカダでも作んな
original_en:
Are you waiting for the boats to sail?
Give up! Those ships aren't going anywhere. <PART>
---
I hear the pirates are burning ships.
If you really gotta go, try making a raft!

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: まったく… こっちは食品を〓ってるんだ早く復航してくれないと〓品がダメになっちまう
original_en:
I'm stuck! My cargo is all foodstuffs. If
the ships don't sail soon, it'll all spoil.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: まったく 何て事してくれたんだろうねディパンへは船でしか行けないのに <PART> これじゃ〓売あがったりだよ！海賊なんて ロクなもんじゃないね
original_en:
They've really gone and done it this time!
The only way to reach Dipan is by boat. <PART>
---
My business is ruined!
Good-for-nothing pirates!

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 海賊の襲撃といっても相手は一人だったらしいよ物も奪われなかったそうだし… 不思議だねえ
original_en:
Pirate raid? It was only one guy!
He didn't even take anything. Weird.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: 状況に進〓はまったく無しだせっかくヴィルノアの鉄〓を取り〓せたってのに <PART> それにしても 最近急激に鉄〓の注〓が〓えたな戦争でも始めるわけじゃあるまいし…
original_en:
I acquired all this steel from Villnore,
but the situation hasn't changed at all! <PART>
---
I've received lots of steel orders lately.
Well, it's not like they're starting a war.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: ヴィルノアではいい鉄が〓れるんだクレルモンフェランはいつも注〓してるらしいぜ
original_en:
They make good steel in Villnore.
That's where Crell Monferaigne get theirs.

speaker: Boy
original_jp: 手持ちの本 全て〓み終わったしそろそろ新しいのが欲しいんだけど… <PART> この状況じゃ 相当遅れそうだね別のルートから取り〓せた方が早いかな…
original_en:
I've read through all my books.
I'd like to get some new ones, <PART>
---
but the way things look, it'll be a while.
Guess I'll order from someplace else.

speaker: Boy
original_jp: やっぱりソルデじゃできる事が限られちゃうよね一般人でも魔法を学べる場所があればいいのに…
original_en:
You can only do so much in Solde. I'd
like a place for commoners to learn magic.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: 海賊の次は渡航〓否か国を閉ざして 何の利〓があるってんだ？
original_en:
First pirates and now this ban!
What do they gain by closing the country?

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: ディパンからの渡航〓否〓言で街中の人間が不安を訴えている <PART> ソルデだけじゃない 他の国もディパンの不〓な動きが気になっているようだな
original_en:
Dipan's ban on travel has
everyone in town concerned. <PART>
---
And we're not the only ones <PART> ---- <PART> other
countries are worried about Dipan's actions.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 最後の船で帰ってきた人達に聞くとディパンの空気は〓分と張り詰めていたそうだよ <PART> まあ バルバロッサ王と三〓者さえいれば心配はないだろうけど… 気になるねェ
original_en:
People returning on the last boat told me
they felt tension in the air in Dipan. <PART>
---
As long as they have King Barbarossa and
the Three Mages, they'll be fine. Still...

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: ディパンで何か起きるんだろうかねェソルデにこれ以上影〓がなきゃいいんだけど
original_en:
I wonder what'll happen in Dipan. I just
hope it doesn't end up hurting Solde more.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 海賊見たい！ だなんて言ってられない〓〓気になっちゃったなあ…
original_en:
If I were you, I wouldn't go around
blabbing how you wanna see the pirates.

speaker: Boy
original_jp: まさか このままずっとディパンに渡れないなんて事は…無いよね？
original_en:
It's not like we'll never be able
to go to Dipan again...or is it?

speaker: Girl
original_jp: ねえ ディパンはどうなっちゃったの！？ディパンの人達は無事なの！？
original_en:
Tell me, what happened in Dipan?
Is everybody there alright?

speaker: Boy
original_jp: ディパンには三〓者がいるんだから大丈夫だよね？魔法で何とかなるんだよね？
original_en:
Dipan has the Three Mages, so I'm sure
they have some magic up their sleeves.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: 今ディパンに渡ろうなんざ自殺行〓だ！誰も船は出さねえよ <PART> どうしても渡りたきゃ〓いで行くんだな〓き〓えはゴメンだ
original_en:
It's suicide to cross over to Dipan now!
No one's sailing! <PART>
---
If you really want to get there, you'd
better start swimming. Count me out!

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: これが神の怒りだとしたら恐らく… ディパンは…
original_en:
If this is what the gods' wrath is like,
I shudder to think of Dipan's fate.

speaker: Boy
original_jp: 街を出て行く事になったから…この本やるよあんまり面白くないと思うけど
original_en:
I'm headed out. Here, take this book.
I don't know if you'll like it or not.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: …ありがとう 私 〓はよく〓めないけど頑張って〓強するね
original_en:
Thank you! I can't read so well,
but I'll give it a shot!

speaker: Boy
original_jp: 全部〓めるようになったらさ新しい本を〓るから …絶対
original_en:
Tell you what. If you read the whole thing,
I'll send you a new one. I guar-an-tee!

speaker: Girl
original_jp: うん …待ってるね
original_en: Nice! I'll be waiting for it!

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 〓住先で落ち着いたら教えてね〓強して 手〓を書けるようにしておくから
original_en:
Let me know when you find a place to live.
I'll learn to write and mail you a letter!

speaker: Boy
original_jp: お前の手〓か…ちゃんと〓めるような〓で書いてくれよな
original_en:
I'll be looking forward to it.
Write nice and neat so I can read it!

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: 一気に仕事が減ったよ…何をしていいかわからん 〓が真っ白だ <PART> 今までディパンの仕事しかして無かったからなこの年で 別の仕事を探すにしても…
original_en:
All the jobs up and disappeared.
What do I do now? I don't have a clue. <PART>
---
All I've ever done is work for Dipan.
I can't learn a new trade at my age.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: この船 手放さなきゃならんな…〓持〓だけでも手一〓だしな…
original_en:
I'm going to have to let this ship go.
I can't afford to maintain it.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: やはり ディパンは神の怒りを受けたんだな…これから俺達はどうすればいいんだ…
original_en:
Dipan incurred the wrath of the gods,
but we're also being made to suffer.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: ディパンの王様も王妃様もみんな神様に罰せられたって…本当？
original_en:
Did the gods really punish the king
and queen of Dipan?

speaker: Boy
original_jp: …お父さんが ディパンが滅ぶのならソルデでは生活できないから…出て行こうって…
original_en:
Daddy said if Dipan falls apart, we can't
live in Solde, so we'll have to leave.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: ディパンが無くなったら戦争が起きるかもしれないってみんな言ってた <PART> ソルデには闘う力も それ以前に暮らすための手段も無いから 早く出て行ったほうが良いって <PART> でも 当ての無い人や 出て行くお金が無い人だっているのに…
original_en:
Everyone is saying that without Dipan,
there will probably be a war. <PART>
---
They say that in Solde there are no means of
living, let alone fighting, so it's time to leave. <PART>
---
But what about the people with no
money and no place to go?

speaker: Girl
original_jp: みんな 街を出て行っちゃった…ソルデはどうなるのかな…
original_en:
Everyone left town.
I wonder what will become of Solde.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: もう ここに居てもロクな仕事は無いってわかってはいるんだがな <PART> 情け無い事に 船に乗る以外俺には何もできねえんだよ
original_en:
I know that even if I stay,
there won't be any work. <PART>
---
But sad as it sounds, outside of sailing,
there's nothing I can do.

speaker: Sailor
original_jp: クレルモンフェランにでも行ってみるか…確か あそこには水軍があったはずだしな
original_en:
Perhaps I'll head to Crell Monferaigne.
I heard they have a navy!

speaker: Cat
original_jp: にゃにゃにゃ！？お主 我〓の言葉がわかるとニャ！？ <PART> 〓しい人間もいたものだニャふむふむ 興味深いミャ～ <PART> 街から人が消えたせいか我〓の〓い主も元気がないのだニャ <PART> どうやら あの少年がいなくなったのが一番こたえたようだニャ
original_en:
Supurrb!
Mew know what I'm saying!? <PART>
---
What an interesting purrson!
Meow do mew do it? <PART>
---
My owner's been feeling down
with all the people leaving town. <PART>
---
It really hit her hard when
that boy disappeared.

speaker: Cat
original_jp: 若いというのはいいものニャ〓せよ乙女ニャ <PART> お主も良い〓をするといいニャ〓〓気に流されてはダメだニャ！
original_en:
It's good to be young!
Love is all around! <PART>
---
Mew should find somebody!
Just don't get lost in the moment!
